title: Wire dynamic HDR x265 parameters
summary: Threads explicit Dynamic HDR preservation artifact paths through the existing encode attempt and video-flag builders, with descriptor-owned x265 parameter emission for CPU/libx265 HDR plans only.
reason: Dynamic HDR preservation already had detection, tool discovery, and pure planning, but no guarded way for a future backend extraction step to supply Dolby Vision RPU or HDR10+ JSON artifacts to x265. This slice adds the argument plumbing without enabling extraction, routing changes, or real-media preservation claims.
behavior_before: Encode argument builders only emitted static HDR10 x265 parameters. There was no supported path for Dolby Vision RPU or HDR10+ JSON x265 parameters, and no explicit guard preventing future callers from trying to pass such paths to NVENC or SDR plans.
behavior_after: Encode argument builders accept optional DolbyVisionRpuPath, DolbyVisionTargetProfile, and Hdr10PlusJsonPath inputs. Descriptor-owned CPU/libx265 HDR plans append dolby-vision-rpu, dolby-vision-profile=8.1, VBV defaults, and dhdr10-info when supplied. NVENC, dormant primary descriptor evidence paths, SDR plans, unsupported Dolby Vision target profiles, and colon-bearing paths fail closed.
manual_validation: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\scripts\dev\check_powershell_analysis.ps1 - skipped: PSScriptAnalyzer is not installed
rollback_plan: Revert the dynamic HDR parameter helpers and parameter threading in ops/pipeline/engine/decide/encoder_descriptors.ps1 and encode_policy.ps1, remove the added encode flag snapshot/guard assertions, restore docs to the prior Dynamic HDR open-work wording, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the targeted encode/Dynamic HDR checks.

No extraction commands are run, no routing is changed, no source/output/pending-publish files move, and no real-media preservation claim is made.
